title: Updates — Samiul Hasan
description: What Samiul Hasan is working on now, plus a timestamped log of engineering experience, research publications, and milestones.

now.title: Intern Engineer at Pacific Power Tech & Research Assistant at IUB
now.detail: Preparing Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) and procurement BOQs, conducting substation inspections, designing rooftop solar PV (PVsyst), and advancing optical dust sensor and power electronics manuscripts.

entries.title: Journal Paper Submitted to Sage
entries.detail: Submitted 'Environmental Compensation and Physics-Informed Machine Learning Calibration of a Low-Cost Optical Dust Sensor for PM2.5 and AQI Monitoring' to Indoor and Built Environment.

entries.title: Joined Pacific Power Tech as Intern Engineer
entries.detail: Working on electrical Single Line Diagrams (AutoCAD Electrical), substation inspections (HT/LT switchgear, transformers, grounding), and a 2,232 sq. ft. rooftop solar PV design in PVsyst.

entries.title: Presented at IEEE PEEIACON 2026
entries.detail: Presented 'High Step-Up Interleaved Boost Converter with Coupled Inductors and Cascadable Symmetric Voltage Multiplier Cell' in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

entries.title: Paper Accepted at iCACCESS 2026
entries.detail: Co-authored accepted paper on an Au/ITO dual-layer photonic crystal fiber surface plasmon resonance biosensor for label-free cancer cell discrimination.

entries.title: Paper Published at IEEE EICT 2025
entries.detail: Numerical investigation of ZrN-ITO coated photonic crystal fiber plasmonic refractive index sensor published in IEEE conference proceedings.

entries.title: Vice Chairperson — IEEE Photonics Society IUB Student Branch
entries.detail: Led planning and execution of departmental workshops (including Radio Astronomy) and coordinated educational industrial visit to BTCL.

entries.title: Efficiency for Access Design Challenge UK — IKEA Foundation Grant
entries.detail: Awarded grant funding of BDT 35,000 by Energy Saving Trust & IKEA Foundation to develop an off-grid solar thermal dehydrator.

entries.title: Champion — Line Following Robot Competition
entries.detail: Won First Place in the Line Following Robot Competition at IUB EEE Innovation Fest 2024.
